newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan FGEP group buys 216,000T US corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan FGEP group buys 216,000T US corn at tender.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group bought four 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. No.2 corn at a tender on Friday, traders said.
The 216,000-tonne tender is unusually large tender for FGEP group -- Taiwan's largest corn buying interest, traders said.
"This is the first time that the FGEP group bought four shipments on the same day," a Taipei-based U.S. trader said. "The group normally buys one shipment per month."
Traders said the FGEP group's decision to move up its tender schedule is a reflection on its buyers' bullish view on the Chicago futures market.
"The group's buyers must have anticipated for a corn futures rally," another trader said.
A group buyer said, however, China's active corn exports to Japan and South Korea would limit a possible Chicago corn rally.
"Major Japanese and South Korean buyers have completed most of this year's corn buying with many shipments supplied by China," he told Reuters by telephone.
"There won't be more additional demands for U.S. corn from this region until the end of this year," he added.
The FGEP group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprise, President Enterprise, Ever Smile Feed Mill Co and Fong Yu.
All four 54,000-tonne shipments were bought on a cost-and-freight basis, traders said.
Details for the tender are as follows:
One Mitsui Oct 1-15 Oct 16-30 82.55 US cents/Dec 97
Two Mitsui Nov 1-15 Nov 16-30 88.03 US cents/Dec 97
Three Agrex Dec 1-15 Dec 16-30 90.73 US cents/Dec 97
Four Mitsui Jan 1-15 Jan 16-30 89.41 US cents/Mar 98
